label: MANUAL/FOUNDER_DIRECTED pilot
limitations: Tool-call, source, and time budgets of an external Grok Cloud agent are self-reported on the result file. Ingest enforces those reported numbers against the charter cap. It does not meter the agent's actual calls.
Independence is by separate agent execution plus the same-actor ledger. It is not cryptographic and not an operating-system identity check.

EG-01 is RECORD_IMMUTABLE in the generated descriptor, including operational_status and investigator_charter_id. A status rewrite is rejected. Disposition is recorded on IR-01 when an IC-01 exists, and in the ingest journal. The stored gap stays at its current status.
Desk-research-only work cannot move SCUTTLEBUTT to COMPLETE. QAD-MODERN-SCUTTLEBUTT-PROTOCOL.md §1: scuttlebutt is not desk research. The stage may be IN_PROGRESS or INCOMPLETE.

No RB-01 is written. The Research Budget Controller has not approved the caps. RC-01 stays DRAFT. The Evidence Intelligence Lead has not validated the charter. The Research Director does not self-authorize the budget.

H1–H5 for this pilot are Director-drafted from QAD-FULL-RESEARCH-PROTOCOL.md §2 applied to UNH. They are not Founder-approved. MANUAL_PILOT is not a canonical entry_route. The case entry route remains FOUNDER_DIRECTED.
Provenance checks require a URL, retrieval timestamp, source date, and publisher. The boundary does not re-fetch the URL. Admitted bytes are the quotation in the result file.

qad.m53.retry_kernel meters canonical stage retries (initial plus 3). It is not used to retry an external specialist. Those runs are outside this process, and a self-reported failure is not a kernel retry.

Management & Capital Allocation has no IC-01 investigator_type. That charter is a desk assignment bound to the gap. It is not a new schema. Its claims still enter through the existing admission boundary.
